## Appearance

Dick Moore is a big, handsome man who has badly gone to fat over time. He has a broad, round, red face with vacant eyes. He also exhibits a unique physical trait, possessing one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Dick Moore is described as being mentally deficient and behaving like a big baby, which can occasionally be annoying. However, he is capable of shoveling snow and considers the task to be great fun.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P30](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P31](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P31](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0031)_

## History

Dick Moore inherited a sea-going streak from his mother and divided his time between sailing in the summer, working in his father's store in the winter, and owning a dog named [Carlo](../character/carlo.md). He settled with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) on the West place for a winter, but he was a drunkard who went to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to visit relatives before dying of yellow fever in Cuba thirteen years prior. A letter eventually revealed that the man long believed to be Dick was actually his lookalike cousin, [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P44](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0044), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), +2 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--dick-moore.md)

Dick Moore acts as a fond acquaintance toward [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), following her around like a child. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently visits his household, and she learns more about his situation through conversations with Captain Jim. Ultimately, a letter received by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reveals that the man long believed to be Dick is actually his cousin, as the real Dick died years prior.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), +10 more_

- Friend of — fond acquaintance who follows her around like a child (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS CORNELIA ARRANGES MATTERS P28](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0028)</sub>

### [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick-moore--george-moore.md)

[George Moore](../character/george-moore.md) is the double cousin of Dick Moore. Because the two men were lookalikes, George was mistaken for Dick for years until a medical trip to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) revealed that Dick had actually died years earlier.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), +4 more_

- Relative of — double cousins (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), +1 more</sub>

### [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick-moore--leslie-moore.md)

Dick Moore was married to [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), who took care of him in their home. [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) secretly wept over the hardship of her situation before arranging for him to undergo surgery in [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal). It was eventually revealed that the man she believed to be her husband was actually Dick's cousin George, and that Dick had died years ago.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), +27 more_
